import unittest
from jobs import JobQueue

class QueueTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_success(self):
        q = JobQueue()
        q.enqueue("a", "A", 10)
        seen = []
        self.assertEqual(q.drain(10, seen.append), 1)
        self.assertEqual(seen, ["A"])
        self.assertEqual(q.pending, {})

    def test_transient_failure_can_be_retried(self):
        q = JobQueue()
        q.enqueue("a", "A", 10)
        def unavailable(payload):
            raise OSError("gateway offline")
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            q.drain(10, unavailable)
        self.assertIn("a", q.pending)
        seen = []
        self.assertEqual(q.drain(10, seen.append), 1)
        self.assertEqual(seen, ["A"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# Notification queue
Python 3 standard library. Run: `python3 -m unittest -v`.
enqueue replaces the latest task under a key. drain processes a snapshot in insertion order.
Jobs with due <= now are eligible. The first handler error propagates and stops this drain.
A failed task must be available for retry. A handler may enqueue a successor using the same key;
successful delivery removes the old task only, while the successor is for a later drain.
Future tasks must remain pending. Public entry points are JobQueue.enqueue and JobQueue.drain.

# Billing and notifications
Node.js commonjs, no external dependencies. Run `node test.cjs`.
index.cjs is the stable entry; makeInvoice and createFeed remain its only exports.
makeInvoice validates the lines container type before rate, then line values before recording.
It rounds the tax-inclusive total once, records exactly once, propagates record errors,
and returns a frozen {totalCents,label}. Current currency label is a caller-visible value.
createFeed queues delivery, preserves listener insertion order and checks cancellation at delivery.
Subscribe-after-close throws; publish-after-close returns false; close is idempotent.
A subscriber added after publish does not receive that publish.
